fan.speed_evidence: User inference from model; SIBOOR BOM lists 24V 8000RPM 4010 fans, exact part P-Q curve not found.
fan.boundary_model: Pressure-driven annular inlet at the SB CAD fan outlet; not rotating blades.
fan.pressure_note: Assumed sensitivity conditions, not the measured SIBOOR fan curve.

thermal_conditions.rated_power_note: Not assumed to be continuous heat input under temperature control.
thermal_conditions.heater_block_material: Nickel-plated copper alloy, Phaetus product specification
thermal_conditions.heatbreak_material: Stainless steel with EndCoat, Phaetus product specification
thermal_conditions.heatsink_material: User-assumed aluminum; the isothermal-surface model does not solve its solid conductivity.
thermal_conditions.thermal_model_status: Completed exploratory steady RANS airflow and isothermal-surface passive-scalar heat transfer at 10/25/50 Pa. 250/300 C block scenarios use a separate illustrative thermal network with unknown G; no conjugate solid/air heat transfer was solved.

geometry.hotend_source: Rapido X.STEP, solid 1; groove mount solid 0 excluded for screw-mounted setup

geometry.wires: Not modeled in initial comparison; photographs retained as assembly references, not published.
geometry.main_body: Rapido UHF long cowling, same in both cases
